label_policy: Positive patches reverse an official gold bug-fix patch from a distinct Issue-PR pair. Negative controls are forward accepted gold fixes from 25 other Issue-PR pairs and are labeled only as having no target defect from the source issue; they are not claimed globally bug-free.
review_input_policy: Only unified diff text and a neutral synthetic PR title are provided to reviewers. The source issue statement and gold-fix direction are withheld.
